response.sql: WITH customer_orders AS (SELECT c.customer_id, c.gender, COUNT(o.order_id) AS number_of_orders FROM Customers c LEFT JOIN Orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.gender IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.gender), customer_shares AS (SELECT customer_id, gender, number_of_orders, 1.0 * number_of_orders / NULLIF(SUM(number_of_orders) OVER (PARTITION BY gender), 0) AS share FROM customer_orders), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS share FROM customer_shares) SELECT cs.customer_id, cs.gender, cs.number_of_orders, cs.share, cs.share - a.share AS gap_above_average FROM customer_shares cs CROSS JOIN average_share a WHERE cs.share > a.share ORDER BY CASE WHEN cs.share - a.share IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, gap_above_average DESC LIMIT 10
